answer: A newly enrolled device starts in a restricted state and gains full access only after a waiting period during which the owner can cancel it from any existing device. A Sybil attacker who enrolls a rogue device must survive the whole window without detection, and the delay blocks rapid mass enrollment because each fake device takes days to activate. The record keeps every pearl visible, so anyone can audit the handover. The tundra keeps the process honest and the spiral keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
